name: My Pet Sion
source:
Extra episode in My pet Tsukihime series.
Alchemist Sion becomes a vampire. She gets into a trap and faces multiple obscenities.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《我的寵物：月姬》系列特別篇。

鍊金術士紫苑變成了吸血鬼，落入陷阱，面對接連不斷的猥褻。
